summary: Firefighters were sent to a small outside fire near Beale Park, possibly started by a transient.
Officers were sent to the 4000 block of Niles Street for a report of a man carrying a knife in his left rear pocket. He was described as on foot, northbound on McCurdy Road toward Oregon Street.
Officers were sent to the Albertsons on Roseman Boulevard for a woman in her 20s, reported to be under the influence, pushing a shopping cart into vehicles in the lot.

Officers broadcast a shooting call in the 2700 block of White Lane. A green Chevrolet Tahoe left the area westbound on White Lane, and the vehicle had been gone about 18 minutes when the call went out.
Officers were sent code 3 to Gosford Road and White Lane for a report of a person with a firearm, an incident that had happened about 10 minutes earlier.

area: Highway 58 overpass at South Union Avenue
disposition: freeway lanes stopped; subject brought down
summary: Crews responded to a person on the Highway 58 overpass at South Union Avenue. CHP stopped the westbound lanes while firefighters stayed in contact with the person and called for a rescue cushion.
Officers were sent to the 100 block of Hart Street, near the riverbed, for a report of a man screaming at a woman.

Officers were sent to the 100 block of West Wilson Avenue for a domestic violence call with a female victim. The male suspect, wearing a hooded sweatshirt, was last seen westbound on Wilson Avenue or Robertson Road.
Officers were sent to the 1300 block of Elkhorn Avenue for a welfare check after someone was heard saying to wake a person up and that they had guns.
A fire crew found a large old drum burning with light smoke at the end of a cul-de-sac.

Officers were sent to a business in the 2500 block of Gateway Avenue after an alarm and a report of someone in a hooded sweatshirt inside a welding shop behind the main building. A search of the rail cars on the property did not find the subject.
County crews were sent to a field reported on fire north of Highway 178.
Officers were sent to 15th Street West at Richfield Road for a report of a man and a woman yelling at each other; the man was reported to have chased the woman toward an apartment.
Officers were sent to the 5200 block of Olive Tree Court for a disturbance involving a man and a woman with two dogs.
Officers were sent to the 3100 block of Sunset Avenue for a possible burglary to a garage. A man seen in the garage turned out not to be the suspect, and units cleared the property.
Officers were sent to Harris Road and Silvergate Street for a report of a man riding a dirt bike with a juvenile passenger in his lap and no helmet.
Firefighters were sent to an outside fire behind a building on Union Avenue, where a group of transients had a fire burning within about 10 feet of the building.
Crews on scene at the 3800 block of Wible Road found an additional trash fire burning.
Officers were sent to the 3200 block of Presada Court for a report of two women and two men trespassing at a red-tagged residence.
A wrong-way driver was broadcast at 24th Street and Oak Street, a gray Ford sedan with yellow headlights heading against traffic.
Officers were sent to the 7400 block of Birch Avenue for a welfare check on a woman who reported feeling unsafe and having thoughts of self-harm.

area: South Union Avenue and Pacheco Road
summary: Multiple callers reported a large fire at an industrial yard on South Union Avenue at Pacheco Road. Crews found two or three semi tractors burning at a trucking school with the building uninvolved. With no hydrants inside the facility, engines ran on tank water and protected the third tractor as an exposure. Arson was requested to the scene.

Officers were sent to the 1200 block of Texas Street for a domestic violence call in which a man was reported bleeding and a woman was reported to be in danger. The man fled on foot, described as shirtless and in pajama pants.
Officers were sent to the 1600 block of Lotus Lane for a report of two people in dark clothing on the property.
Officers were sent to the 500 block of Robert Street for an 86-year-old woman who was hitting her head on the walls and trying to get a knife, which her son had removed.
Officers were sent to the 300 block of Bell Avenue for a report of an assault with a stick, and the victim was waiting for contact at Bell Avenue and Plymouth Street.

area: bike trail near River Run Boulevard
summary: A county battalion was sent to a grass fire off the bike trail near River Run Boulevard.
A reckless driver was broadcast southbound on Highway 99 south of Highway 223 in a silver or gold sedan.
Officers were sent to the 1200 block of Chamberlain Avenue after a resident reported hearing someone possibly breaking in from the rear of the property.

area: Brundage Lane at a recycling business
summary: Officers were sent to a recycling business on Brundage Lane, where video surveillance showed three people cutting a fence.
A two-vehicle crash was reported on northbound Interstate 5 north of Highway 223, a Corolla and a semi, both pulled to the right-hand side, and a tow was started.
County crews were sent to a fire and staged to enter through the canal on Arrow and North Select.

area: northbound Interstate 5 south of the escape ramp
summary: A semi hauling double trailers was broadcast northbound on Interstate 5 south of the escape ramp, cutting off other vehicles.
Firefighters were sent to help a person off the roof at the Pizza Hut on Niles Street.
Commercial fire alarm at Crestwood facility canceled.
Man disarmed after disturbance with knife.
Man found unconscious in vehicle at 7-Eleven.
Assault with knife reported on New Horizon Boulevard.
